full_judgment: 2. One Torabuddin was owner of the C.S. plot No. 404 comprising an area of 0.14 acre and C.S. plot No. 400 comprising an area 0.13 acre recorded under khatian No. 1 of mouza Bishapur, Comilla. He transferred the plots to Hasna Banu by two registered deeds of sale in 1934 who transferred the entire plot No. 404 to her daughter Afia Khatun (Appellant No. 2) on 9th February 1952 and the entire plot No. 400 to her son, Abid Ali (respondent No. 1) on 29th April 1984. Afia Khatun transferred the entire plot No. 404 to her daughter Maleka Khatun (appellant No. 1) on 6th March 1975.
